reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Re-established the Dutch degree from its own adopted table, current programme order and exact course/thesis entries, then reconsidered the finished UCR comparison against the active workbook. Shared unchanged research is identified, but the English case’s route and approval are not inherited. This is a separate analytical pass by the same AI, not an independent person.
findings: The current Dutch page lists Work and Organizational Psychology first; Clinical-first is an English-page carryover and is corrected. The Dutch OER explicitly permits this English-taught major within the Dutch track. The chosen Work, Organizational and Diversity courses occupy blocks two, three and four in year two, and the applied PATHS course is offered in block one of year three. Thirty-one credited components form sixty EC per year without combining other majors.

Underlying descriptions establish work motivation, employee differences and selection; organisational attitudes, teams and change; inclusion, belonging and workplace diversity; and a structured organisational-intervention project with feedback. The applied course is not a placement and requires participation, its presentation and individual logs. UCR leadership, organisational psychology and inclusive-leadership work have bounded primary relationships; other projects are not automatically the PATHS counterpart.

Re-read the Dutch first-year skills entries: A must be passed before B, C includes information/plagiarism tests and twenty experimental-subject hours, and the earlier cohort’s zero-credit hours route is not substituted. The full first-year sequence satisfies A-before-B and the hours requirement. General TSB rules remain unchanged, but the Dutch appendix’s all-first-year plus sixty-post-first-year thesis gate controls this exact target. The 550012-B-12 entry confirms 120 credits including first year and hours for September and recommends 138 for February.

The Dutch open-space rule requires twelve of thirty credits from non-selected psychology majors or predefined electives, not merely any psychology-related course. The remaining eighteen stay open. Any alternative requires approval. The quantitative thesis is illustrated without adding an unnecessary methods elective; qualitative and systematic-review variants remain subject to their three-credit condition before submission. No specific minor or host is invented.

Reconsidered fifteen primary relationships from actual content. The Dutch-only Test Theory description was retrieved in Dutch: classical and modern item models, reliability, validity and measurement quality. UCR clinical testing supplies a genuine partial relationship with explicit psychometric limits. Philosophical agency is not personality-trait psychology; qualitative inquiry is not correlational statistics; systematic review is not a full empirical practicum. The clinical and cognitive/data options remain meaningful responses to the generic psychology target and its evidenced interests.

All fifty-five interests were reconciled. Strengthened the closest option’s organisational strand with foundational and inclusive leadership while retaining the broad psychological core. Resolved all three Psycholinguistics conflicts in its actual planned term. All three schedules pass offerings, earlier formal prerequisites, first-year PPD and numerical rules; pairwise differences are forty-five, fifty-two-and-a-half and forty-five credits each way. Read thirty-one English external labels, six notes, three concepts, fifteen positive relationships, explicit blanks and thirty-five unchanged shared course-description entries under the renderer mapping. No app code or runtime behaviour changed.
